positioning: A face full of wrinkles and a heart full of mischief.
story: The Pug looks worried. The Pug is not worried. The Pug is waiting for you to notice it is adorable.

The breed is ancient. Pugs lived in China more than two thousand years ago, where emperors kept them as palace companions. Traders carried them to Holland in the 1500s, and the Pug became a favorite of European courts.
Dutch legend says a Pug named Pompey barked a warning when Spanish soldiers crept toward the Prince of Orange in 1572. The prince lived. The Pug became a hero.
The breed motto is multum in parvo. Much in little. Josephine, wife of Napoleon, kept a Pug named Fortune. Queen Victoria loved them too. The AKC recognized the breed in 1885.
At home, a Pug snores, snorts, and shadows you from room to room. It hogs the couch and the covers. It eats anything and then looks at you for more.
Keep it cool, keep it trim, and expect a lap that is never empty. A group of Pugs is called a grumble. It is the best kind of noise.
rank_cap: Much dog in a small package (AKC)
fblocks: No one knows for sure. One theory is the Latin pugnus, a fist, for the shape of the face.
Pompey, who saved a Dutch prince. Fortune, Josephine Bonaparte’s feisty Pug. Frank, the wisecracking Pug of Men in Black.
Short noses mean noisy breathing and trouble in heat. Watch the weight. Clean the wrinkles daily.
A short, smooth coat in fawn or black. The tail curls tight over the hip. The wrinkles are the trademark.
Fourteen to eighteen pounds. Bred in China over two thousand years ago. Recognized by the AKC in 1885.
days: Old Winston naps on a hay bale in the fair barn, under a patchwork quilt.
The Pug’s motto is multum in parvo. Much in little. Look at that face.
Legend says Pompey the Pug saved a Dutch prince in 1572.
A Pug at an ice cream stand does not beg. He simply stares until it melts.
Meet the baby goat nose to nose. Both of you are startled. Both are fine.
A group of Pugs is called a grumble. Powdered sugar optional.
Old Winston sleeps on the grandstand bench. The lemonade waits beside him.
last_walk:
The Ferris wheel glows, and the midway goes quiet.
Mugsy and Pearl head for the gate. She carries a stuffed prize bigger than her head. He snorts. Neither will explain. Pugs never do. The lights stay on behind them, and the grumble goes home.
